segment_title: AI COULD MOVE INTO YOUR SMART HOME — ON ITS OWN
script_text: Gadgets get hit. Overnight Oct. 11-12, 2026, hackers turned up the refrigeration at hundreds of French supermarkets, up to 122F, fires and spoiled food; no claim of responsibility; no report ties it to AI. France 24 English: worker says opening the fridge 'was like opening an oven'. TF1: manager facing EUR16,000 in spoiled food. NBC Nightly News: U.S. expert says homes here are at risk too.
